'''Maximilian Sebastian Janisch''' (born August 8, 2003)<ref name="sfr">{{cite web|access-date=2016-11-27|publisher=Schweizer Radio und Fernsehen SRF|title=Maximilians Welt – aus dem Leben eines Hochbegabten.|url=https://www.srf.ch/sendungen/dok/maximilians-welt-aus-dem-leben-eines-hochbegabten|website=srf.ch|date=24 April 2015 }}<!-- auto-translated from German by Module:CS1 translator --></ref> is a Swiss [[PhD]] in [[mathematics]]. He defended his [[dissertation]] at the age of 21.<ref name="Diss">Carole Scheidegger: [https://www.news.uzh.ch/en/articles/news/2025/maximilian-janisch.html ''I’ve spent half my life at UZH.''] University of Zurich, 2025-06-20. Retrieved 2025-06-30</ref>  

Janisch showed aptitude for mathematics at a very young age and was described as a {{lang|de|Wunderkind}}, or [[child prodigy]]. After passing his [[high school]] mathematics exams at the age of nine, at the age of twelve, Janisch became the youngest [[university]] student in France, and at the age of eighteen, the youngest doctoral student in Switzerland.<ref name="Belgeri">{{Cite news |last=Belgeri |first=Sara |date=2023-04-08 |title=Das Wunderkind ist erwachsen geworden – und nun der jüngste Doktorand der Schweiz |url=https://magazin.nzz.ch/empfehlungen/maximilian-janisch-ist-der-juengste-doktorand-der-schweiz-ld.1733390 |access-date=2024-02-04 |work=[[Neue Zürcher Zeitung]]}}</ref><ref name=":13">Yannick Nock: ''[https://www.aargauerzeitung.ch/schweiz/wie-das-beruehmteste-wunderkind-der-schweiz-das-schulsystem-aendern-will-131234227 Wie das berühmteste Wunderkind der Schweiz das Schulsystem ändern will].'' [[Schweiz am Wochenende]] from April 17, 2017, pages 2–3.</ref><ref name=":14">{{cite web|access-date=2018-02-13|author=Yannick Nock|title=Mathe-Genie (14) über Frühförderung: «Die Leistung kann darunter leiden»|date=February 2018 |url=https://www.aargauerzeitung.ch/schweiz/mathe-genie-14-ueber-fruehfoerderung-die-leistung-kann-darunter-leiden-132152560}}<!-- auto-translated from German by Module:CS1 translator --></ref>

== Biography ==
Janisch is the son of the German [[professor]] emeritus of mathematics Thomas Drisch<ref>{{citation |mode=cs1 |author1=Gerhard Geosits |author2=Hans-Fredo List |author3=Nora Lohner|date=2004|language=en|pages=270 (bzw. S. 2 im PDF)|title=EXTREME VALUE TECHNIQUES PART II: VALUE PROPOSITION FOR FORTUNE 500 COMPANIES|s2cid=208653112 }}<!-- auto-translated from German by Module:CS1 translator --></ref><ref>{{cite web|access-date=2024-02-04|author=Christian Lauer|date=2018-08-29|title=Das intelligenteste Kind der Welt hat saarländische Gene|url=https://www.sol.de/grossregion/das-intelligenteste-kind-der-welt-hat-saarlaendische-gene,46475.html|website=sol.de}}<!-- auto-translated from German by Module:CS1 translator --></ref> and Monika Janisch,<ref name="Reporter">{{cite web|access-date=2024-08-25|author=Helen Arnet |publisher=Schweizer Radio und Fernsehen SRF|title=Mathematik-Genie Maximilian Janisch – Aus der Welt eines Hochbegabten|language=de|url=https://www.srf.ch/play/tv/reporter/video/mathematik-genie-maximilian-janisch----aus-der-welt-eines-hochbegabten?urn=urn:srf:video:013e0259-c7a0-492c-96c2-df3e3bd6be8f|website=srf.ch|date=8 September 2019}}</ref> who was awarded a doctorate degree in [[Business Administration]] from the [[University of St. Gallen]].<ref>Monika Janisch: [https://www.zvab.com/9783258048116/strategische-Anspruchsgruppenmanagement-Shareholder-Value-Stakeholder-3258048118/plp ''Das strategische Anspruchsgruppenmanagement. Vom Shareholder Value zum Stakeholder Value.''] Haupt, Bern and Stuttgart, 1993 (in German). ISBN 978-3-258-04811-6</ref> Janisch skipped three years of elementary school after achieving an [[IQ]] score of 149+ in the [[Wechsler Intelligence Scale for Children|WISC]] test.<ref name="sfr">{{cite web|access-date=2016-11-27|publisher=Schweizer Radio und Fernsehen SRF|title=Maximilians Welt – aus dem Leben eines Hochbegabten.|url=https://www.srf.ch/sendungen/dok/maximilians-welt-aus-dem-leben-eines-hochbegabten|website=srf.ch|date=24 April 2015 }}<!-- auto-translated from German by Module:CS1 translator --></ref> Janisch was admitted to the high school [[Immensee (village)|Gymnasium Immensee]] at the age of eight, and at the age of nine he passed the [[Matura#Switzerland|Matura]] in mathematics with top marks.<ref name=":1">Rahel Schnüriger/Reno Nägeli: ''Neunjähriger schafft die Mathe-Matura.'' Neue Schweizer Zeitung of June 22, 2013, pages 1 and 28.</ref><ref name="spiegel">{{cite news|access-date=2016-11-27|title=Maximilian der Große|url=https://www.spiegel.de/spiegel/print/d-120780536.html|newspaper=Der Spiegel|date=10 November 2013 |last1=Hardinghaus |first1=Barbara }}<!-- auto-translated from German by Module:CS1 translator --></ref> After completing his Matura in mathematics, Janisch asked to attend the courses and exams of the mathematics study program at the [[ETH Zürich]] and was denied,<ref>Daniel Fuchs: ''Der neunjährige Max will an die ETH.'' Nordwestschweiz of June 21, 2013.</ref><ref>Rahel Schnüriger: ''Neunjähriger will an der ETH studieren.'' [[Neue Luzerner Zeitung]] of June 22, 2013.</ref> receiving significant coverage in Swiss media.<ref name="sfr">{{cite web|access-date=2016-11-27|publisher=Schweizer Radio und Fernsehen SRF|title=Maximilians Welt – aus dem Leben eines Hochbegabten.|url=https://www.srf.ch/sendungen/dok/maximilians-welt-aus-dem-leben-eines-hochbegabten|website=srf.ch|date=24 April 2015 }}<!-- auto-translated from German by Module:CS1 translator --></ref><ref>''[https://www.augsburger-allgemeine.de/panorama/Universitaet-Zuerich-Zehnjaehriger-studiert-Mathe-id27236042.html Zehnjähriger studiert Mathe]''. Augsburger Allgemeine, October 3, 2013.</ref>

Janisch was accepted by the French [[University of Perpignan Via Domitia|University of Perpignan]] in September 2015 as the youngest university student in France in the second year of studies, as it is required to have passed the complete Matura to start university in Switzerland, receiving international media coverage.<ref>Communiqué de presse de l’UPVD. ''Un jeune prodigé de 12 ans intègre l’Université de Perpignan.'' Service de communication de l’Université de Perpignan, Septembre 22, 2015.</ref><ref name=":6">Julien Marlou: ''Un jeune prodige de 12 ans intègre l’université.'' [https://www.lindependant.fr/ L’indépendant] of September 26, 2015.</ref><ref name=":8">Marc-Olivier Fogiel: ''Maximilian Janisch: 12 ans et déjà en 2<sup>e</sup> année de licence.'' RTL-TV, October 13, 2015.</ref><ref name=":9">[https://www.lemonde.fr/etudes-superieures/article/2015/09/25/un-surdoue-de-12-ans-fait-sa-rentree-a-l-universite-de-perpignan_4772001_4468191.html ''Un surdoué de 12 ans fait sa rentrée à l’université de Perpignan.''] [[Le Monde]] of September 25, 2015.</ref><ref>Martine Betti-Cuno: ''La vrai vie des surdoués.'' Magazine Figaro of October 12, 2013, pages 47–49.</ref> 
When Janisch passed the full Swiss [[Matura#Switzerland|Matura]] in August 2018, he enrolled as a mathematics student at the [[University of Zurich]].<ref>{{cite web|access-date=2022-10-23|author=Yannick Nock|date=2019-06-19|publisher=[[Aargauer Zeitung]]|title=Wunderjunge bricht Rekord: Mathe-Genie (15) startet mit dem Master-Studium|url=https://www.aargauerzeitung.ch/schweiz/wunderjunge-bricht-rekord-mathe-genie-15-startet-mit-dem-master-studium-134649047}}<!-- auto-translated from German by Module:CS1 translator --></ref> Janisch has been a doctoral student at the University of Zurich since December 2021. His doctoral advisor was [[Ashkan Nikeghbali]].<ref name="UZH">{{cite web|access-date=2024-07-10
|publisher=University of Zurich, Institute of Mathematics|author=Maximilian Janisch|language=en|title=Maximilian Janisch|url=https://www.math.uzh.ch/en/people?key1=16606&cHash=f2a4d7c1d0a5554ae28d531eaf4258b9|date=2024-03-22}}</ref> In June 2025, he defended successfully his dissertation to be granted a doctorate degree in mathematics.<ref name="Diss" />

There are several documentaries about Janisch,<ref name="Reporter" /> including the cinema documentary ''Maximilian'' (director: Nicolas Greinacher),<ref>{{cite web|access-date=2018-02-12|publisher=[[Aargauer Zeitung]]|title=Film Maximilian|url=https://www.cineman.ch/movie/2016/Maximilian|website=cineman.ch}}<!-- auto-translated from German by Module:CS1 translator --></ref><ref name=":0">{{cite web|access-date=2017-03-03|title=MAXIMILIAN - DER FILM - MAXIMILIAN I 2016 I Dokumentarfilm I DCP I Farbe I 77 Min.|url=http://www.maximilian-derfilm.com/}}<!-- auto-translated from German by Module:CS1 translator --></ref><ref name=":10">Staff Reporter. ''Swiss child prodigy in Derry for film premiere.'' Darry Journal of November 11, 2016, page 22.</ref> which won a Grand Prix at the [[Rhode Island International Film Festival]] in 2018.<ref name="auffuehrungen">''[https://www.maximilian-derfilm.com/auffuehrungen/ AUFFÜHRUNGEN - MAXIMILIAN - DER FILM]'' Accessed on February 4, 2024.</ref>

During 2025 before finishing the requirements for a PhD degree, there was additional media coverage about his achievements and personal lifestyle under the headline ''highly-gifted mathematician''.<ref>Erik Hlacer and Paul Weinheimer: [https://www.faz.net/aktuell/gesellschaft/menschen/ein-hochbegabter-ueber-seine-leidenschaft-vorurteile-und-dating-110506658.html ''Manche überrascht, dass ich Humor habe.''] Interview in: ''[[Frankfurter Allgemeine Zeitung]] (FAZ)'', 2025-06-09. Retrieved am 2025-06-30</ref>
